# Generated by Wave 2 of the OSPS audit (osps-baseline-audit.md).
# Narrowed: the `gomod` ecosystem was removed because backend/go.mod is synced from the
# michielvha/stackweaver monorepo and overwritten on every sync — Go dependencies are
# managed in the monorepo, not here. Only satellite-only ecosystems are scanned.
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "docker"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    groups:
      docker-non-security:
        applies-to: version-updates
        update-types: ["minor", "patch"]
  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    groups:
      github-actions-non-security:
        applies-to: version-updates
        update-types: ["minor", "patch"]

repositories.proposedContents:
version: 2
updates:
  # Swift packages — the single source of truth is SSMConnectKit/Package.swift
  # (the app's local package; ADR-P1). Dependabot reads it + the committed
  # Package.resolved and opens version + security PRs for aws-sdk-swift et al.
  - package-ecosystem: swift
    directory: /SSMConnectKit
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    commit-message:
      prefix: build
    groups:
      swift-deps:
        patterns:
          - "*"

  # GitHub Actions used by the release + CodeQL workflows.
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    commit-message:
      prefix: ci
    groups:
      actions:
        patterns:
          - "*"

version: 2
updates:
  # Go module dependencies
  - package-ecosystem: gomod
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    commit-message:
      # build: keeps these out of the goreleaser changelog (feat/fix/perf/refactor only)
      prefix: build
    groups:
      go-deps:
        patterns:
          - "*"

  # GitHub Actions used by the release workflow
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    commit-message:
      prefix: ci
    groups:
      actions:
        patterns:
          - "*"

version: 2
updates:
  # Keep our own pinned third-party action SHAs fresh (this repo IS the reusable pipeline).
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    commit-message:
      prefix: ci
    groups:
      actions:
        patterns:
          - "*"
